szenen.text: AKE is up {vom_tief} in about two days.
szenen.text_ohne: AKE went almost vertical in two days.

szenen.text: And now shorts are paying longs {funding_abs}, every funding round. Last night it was still positive.
szenen.text_ohne: And now shorts are paying longs, every funding round. Last night it was still positive.

szenen.text: That means the crowd is betting on the top. If price keeps rising, those shorts get squeezed. If it falls, they cash in.
Our estimated liquidation map: the biggest pile of long liquidations sits around 0.006, that is {marke_0_abstand} from here.
szenen.text_ohne: Our estimated liquidation map: the biggest pile of long liquidations sits around 0.006, more than half below the current price.

szenen.text: And a token unlock is coming on November 21st, about 9% of the supply.
Squeeze higher, or does the unlock win? Comment below.
